descriptionChirho: The proper name Joram/Yoram (יְהוֹרָם / יוֹרָם / יֹרָם), meaning 'YHWH is exalted.' Borne by multiple individuals in the Hebrew Bible including: (1) a son of Toi king of Hamath (2 Sam 8:10), (2) a Levite descended from Eliezer son of Moses (1 Chr 26:25), (3) the king of Israel son of Ahab (2 Kgs 8-9), and (4) the king of Judah son of Jehoshaphat (2 Kgs 8:21-24). All multilingual glosses uniformly render the name: Arabic يورام, German/French/English Joram/Yoram, Hindi योराम, Korean 요람. The four auto-clusters merely reflect prepositional prefixes (ל of, ו and) which are inflectional variants, not distinct senses.
